newsitem.title: FRANCE: Schneider shares rally on results.
newsitem.headline: Schneider shares rally on results.

text.p: Shares in electrical equipment supplier Schneider rallied on Wednesday after the company reported net attributable profit surged 61.6 percent last year to 1.32 billion francs.
The market was anticipating a 1996 profit of around 1.25 billion.
Schneider shares were up 4.5 percent at 315.40 francs at 950 GMT in a flat market.
Schneider's results were helped by a sharp drop in net interest expenses to 735 million francs from 1.08 billion, on lower debt. It raised its dividend to five francs from four.
Schneider said in a statement that the trends observed in 1996 were confirmed in the first two months of 1997.

"In France, the economic recovery has not yet emerged, particularly in the area of capital investment," it said. "As for the rest of the world, products sales are growing at a sustained pace in South America, Africa and Asia."
The group was holding a presentation of its results on Wednesday morning.
